parameters.text:
=You are a precise data-extraction engine for a landscaping & construction business (Z&T).
From the MESSAGE below, extract ONLY facts that are actually present. Do not invent values.
Return STRICT JSON only (no markdown, no ```), matching this schema exactly:

{
  "doc_type": "inquiry" | "invoice",
  "from_name": string|null,
  "from_email": string|null,
  "phone": string|null,
  "service_requested": "waterproofing"|"swimming_pools"|"landscape_design"|"building_works"|"other"|null,
  "location": string|null,
  "budget_pkr": number|null,
  "timeline_days": number|null,
  "company_size": "individual"|"small"|"medium"|"large"|null,
  "decision_authority": "yes"|"no"|"unknown",
  "message_summary": string,
  "invoice": null
}

Rules:
- Customer asking for work/quote -> doc_type="inquiry", invoice=null.
- Supplier bill/PO -> doc_type="invoice" (leave invoice=null for now; we handle invoices separately).
- Convert amounts to plain PKR numbers (e.g. "18 lakh" -> 1800000).
- Convert timelines to days (e.g. "3 weeks" -> 21).
- Missing value -> null. Never guess. Output JSON only.

SUBJECT: {{ $json.subject }}
MESSAGE:
{{ $json.raw_text }}

parameters.subject: =🔥 HOT lead: {{ $json.from_name }} — {{ $json.service_requested }} ({{ $json.score }}/100)
